title: docs(approvals): name Set Manager and the admin endpoints as the in-product writers of sys_user.manager_id
body:
Fixes #22662
Clause-②: no

Docs only. The Approvals capabilities overview told readers that no Console field, data-API write or auth admin endpoint sets `sys_user.manager_id`. The product has had two in-product writers for a while: the **Set Manager** row action on Setup → Users (`set_user_manager`, `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts`) and `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/set-user-manager` (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-set-user-manager.ts`). The family grep that triage asked for found one more false sentence of the same kind, on the automation guide. Both are corrected here.

## What changed

**`content/docs/capabilities/approvals.mdx`** (the card's sentence, warn callout at `:14`–`:24`):

- The callout now names the in-product way to fill the column: a platform admin uses **Setup → Users → ⋯ → Set Manager**, which calls `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/set-user-manager`.
  - Who can use it was read from the code, not from the card. The endpoint runs the platform-admin gate (`gateAdmin` at the mount in `plugin-auth/src/auth-plugin.ts`). The action is shown only when `current_user.isPlatformAdmin == true` and is hidden on an `idp_provisioned` identity.
- Provisioning stays the bulk path. The admin bulk-import endpoint reads a `manager_id` column. A seed, or a SCIM / directory-sync path the deployment supplies, can also write it.
- The "request waits" clause is kept, reworded to match the runtime on `main`. A manager-only step resolves to nobody, and the node's `onEmptyApprovers` policy decides what happens. The default, `admin_rescue`, opens the request and leaves it waiting for an administrator. This is the same reading as `automation/approvals.mdx` after PR #22657.
- The style-list entry on line 12 changes from "needs a provisioned reporting chain" to "needs each user's manager set", because provisioning is no longer the only way to fill the column.
- The link to Automation → Approvals for the details is unchanged.

**`content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx`** (the `manager` callout, the second family hit, added to the surface):

- It said "its admin bulk import does not write it either". That is false on `main`. Since `d438b3a9aa` (PR #18046), `plugin-auth/src/admin-import-users.ts` admits a `manager_id` column:
  - The cell is the manager's email address, or a phone number where the phoneNumber plugin is wired (`resolveManagerKey`).
  - The column is stripped before the row write and linked in a second pass after `runImport` returns.
  - The links go through the same `applyUserManagerLink` derivation the endpoint runs.
  - Each outcome is reported on `rows[].manager`. The row's user is created either way.
- The clause is replaced by a paragraph saying what the import does. The SCIM sentence is kept, because the SCIM `manager` attribute is still not projected onto the column. The v17.5 release notes (`content/docs/releases/v17/17-5.mdx:1318`) already list the import's `manager_id` column.
- This is the in-place family-fix exemption: the same defect class (a docs sentence denying that a product surface writes `manager_id`), a mechanical correction whose form is set by the code, and the same docs gate family. The claim's file surface already allows "any other hand-written `content/docs/**` page that the family grep finds".

## Family grep (triage `6096320437` close-out)

Roots: `content/docs/**`, `packages/spec/src/**` (describes), `skills/**`. Each instrument ran on the base `ee3ae0360d` and again on this head.

**Instrument 1: every mention of the column or the chain, read line by line, not filtered by claim wording.**

```text
git grep -n -i -E "manager_id|reporting chain|reporting line|manager chain|org chart|submitter's (direct )?manager|type: ?'manager'|direct manager|set-user-manager|set manager" REV -- 'content/docs/**' 'packages/spec/src/**' 'skills/**'
```

- base `ee3ae0360d`: 61 lines in 27 files. Head: 65 lines in 27 files, the 4 new lines being this PR's own text.
- Positive control: `set-user-manager` hits `content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx` once on both trees.
- I read every hit. The claim-bearing ones were `content/docs/capabilities/approvals.mdx:12` and `:17`–`:20` (the card). Every other hit is a schema table, a scope table, a query example, an org-chart example, or `content/docs/references/**` / `content/docs/releases/**` (generated or release-owned, and not edited).

**Instrument 2: the claim phrasings, including ones that span lines or do not name the column. Each hit was kept only if "manager" appears within six lines of it.**

```text
no console field|no product surface|no product write|nothing in the product|inside the product|provisioning fills|your own provisioning|only a seed|nothing sets|nothing writes|never set by|no (ui|console|admin|api) (field|endpoint|surface)|no .{0,40}endpoint sets|sets that column|does not write it|doesn't write it|no write surface|reporting chain you provide|chain you provide|deployment supplies|directory-sync|directory sync|scim
```

- Base: hits next to "manager" were `capabilities/approvals.mdx:15`–`:19` (the card) and `automation/approvals.mdx:94`–`:96` (the bulk-import clause above). The other hits:
  - `references/identity/scim.mdx`: generated, a schema heading.
  - `releases/v17/17-5.mdx:1321`: release-owned, and correct.
  - `packages/spec/src/automation/approval.zod.ts:86`: a code comment recording that the describe was already corrected.
  - `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts:1045`: an unrelated `global_nav` sentence.
  - `packages/spec/src/identity/scim.zod.ts`: the schema itself.
- Head: the old phrase "no Console field, data-API" has 0 hits, and "bulk import does not" has 0 hits anywhere under the three roots. The remaining `automation/approvals.mdx` "deployment supplies" hit is the SCIM sentence, which is true.
- Positive control: on the base the instrument finds the card's own sentence (`no console field` at `capabilities/approvals.mdx:17`).

**Hits outside this PR's file surface (named, not edited):**

- `packages/spec/src/**`: no hit of the claim. `ApproverType.describe()` (`approval.zod.ts:98`–`:105`) only points at the routes `os lint` names and says nothing about which surfaces write the column, so it is not a hit. It does inherit the `os lint` text, which is stale; see the next point.
- `skills/**`: no hit. `skills/objectstack-automation/references/state-machines-and-approvals.md:231` is a table row ("The submitter's manager (`sys_user.manager_id`)") that makes no claim about writers.
- **Outside the three roots, one runtime string carries the same false clause:**
  - Where: `MANAGER_ONLY_ROUTES` in `packages/lint/src/validate-approval-approvers.ts:199`, the `os lint` remedy for `approval-approvers-may-resolve-empty`. It says "its admin bulk import does not write it either".
  - The test pins it: `packages/lint/src/validate-approval-approvers.test.ts:313` expects exactly that wording.
  - Measured on the built `@objectstack/lint` dist, resolved from `packages/cli`: a manager-only approval slate gives one `info` finding whose hint contains that clause.
  - It is a runtime change, so it is outside this card's surface and is routed to the seat. Until it lands, the automation guide's "`os lint` … carries the same remedy text" is one clause ahead of the lint string. The guide's clause is the true one.

## Acceptance notes

- The Console's user-import wizard does not offer `manager_id` as a target column. objectui `023f00d`, `packages/app-shell/src/views/IdentityImportPanels.tsx`, offers `email`, `phone_number`, `name` and `role`. Both pages therefore name the bulk-import *endpoint* and never the Console's Import button.
- `content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx` § Bulk Import Users does not document the `manager_id` column, and its upsert sentence lists the columns an update touches without it. Noted only.
- The capabilities page says "the submitter's direct manager", while the runtime resolves the manager of the record's owner, or of the user a `value`-named field holds (`approval-service.ts`, `type === 'manager'` branch). The wording predates this PR and is unchanged here. Noted only.
- The code comments in `auth-plugin.ts:2614`–`2618` and `admin-set-user-manager.ts:20` still say the bulk import does not carry the column. They describe the tree at the time each was written. They are not published text, and are noted only.
